# Limitations

Our claim is scoped to Gemma~3 270M, the PT+affine Gemma Scope~2 CLT
dictionary, occupation \(a\)/\(an\) prompts, and the interventions we ran.
The model is in a weak behavioral regime for this task. We did not isolate
a pure context concept \(A\), nor run dedicated semantic-concept probes
beyond noun-token outcomes. S1 was selected using article and future-token
attributions, so the paper identifies the causal decomposition of this
specific handle rather than the model's unique internal ontology. The
19-prompt article-switch ratio is descriptive because it conditions on an
observed switch, and TV distances are not additive mediation effects.
The seven-twin residual estimate is small-\(N\), while several
same-article targets remain floor-limited.

The full-residual reference is patched at the article-token position and
therefore validates sensitivity of noun computation there, not sensitivity
of every pre-article planning site. Conversely, the sparse propagation
diagnostic measures CLT features rather than native residual geometry.
Large \(5\times\) sparse amplification may be off-manifold; affine skip
means sparse interventions need not exhaust MLP computation. Scale,
model-family, task, and sampling-policy generalization remain open.
